thread:
Ryan: Heads up — EMEA MQLs dipped ~35% in the pulseboard right after Monday's launch. graphs look like a sudden drop at 10:03 UTC. anyone else seeing this? <link-to-pulseboard>
Maya: saw that too. quick eyeball of inbound rules shows `webinar_signup_eu` routing to the US queue. might be a tag/UTM mismatch from the launch form update.
Samira: digging into raw events now. initial find: ~12k sessions with utm_campaign=\"launch-emea\" but utm_medium=(not set). SQL quick check:

```
SELECT id, email, utm_campaign, utm_medium, country, created_at
FROM leads
WHERE created_at > '2026-03-16'
  AND (utm_campaign = 'launch-emea' OR utm_medium IS NULL);
```

Samira: about 1,200 leads hit the bad-path where the region hidden field wasn't populated.
Lee: can we backfill in SF by matching IP -> country or by form session id? low lift: map leads where country in [FR, DE, NL, ES] -> EU queue.
Maya: I'll patch the GTM rule and re-run the routing sync. ETA ~30m. will annotate the pulseboard to avoid confusion in today's stand.
deploy-bot: GTM rule update pushed to staging at 2026-03-17T11:15Z; scheduled rollout to prod in ~10m.
Samira: for the KPI deck — include 7d vs 14d attribution windows. the 35% drop narrows to ~8% when using 14d lookback, so it's partly an attribution window/latency effect.
Lee: +1. Also propose we run a quick messaging A/B for EU (variant B has shorter copy & CTA). If routing is fixed we can restart the test next week.
Maya: patched the rule in prod and triggered manual reroute for affected leads. annotated pulseboard: \"2026-03-17 — regional UTM missing -> manual reroute applied\" :white_check_mark:
Samira: starting reprocessing job for the cohort now. will push updated MQL counts to pulseboard and the KPI sheet by EOD.
Ryan: great. For tomorrow's weekly KPI review please add a slide: (1) corrected vs uncorrected MQL counts, (2) root cause (form GTM change + missing hidden field), (3) mitigations (GTM validation, alert for utm_missing >5%, backfill process), (4) impact on forecast.
Maya: will add slide + set a persistent alert for utm_missing > 5% on campaign traffic. tagging @Samira when numbers are in.
Samira: pushed initial corrected numbers to the sheet. I'll update the pulseboard once reprocessing completes. :thumbsup:
Ryan: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. we'll review the slide in the 9am KPI sync tomorrow.
